component: fills ledger, order lifecycle, live analytics input
summary: No production code writes the fills table and orders.local_status never leaves NEW, so live analytics see zero trades; deferred item 20D-01 is recorded CLOSED although the gap is open.
expected: Every exchange fill of a system order is stored once in fills and the order row ends FILLED / CANCELED / EXPIRED.
actual: record_fill has no caller; stream_persistence.py:258-298 only calls update_order_exchange_state (local_status untouched) and transition_order only from UNKNOWN; normalize_live_outcomes skips orders without fills (live_outcomes.py:270-271).
impact: Demo campaign cannot be evaluated from the database (silently 0 trades); on mainnet no durable per-fill record of real-money trades and any live report or gate sees nothing.
evidence: grep record_fill|fill_to_row in src: only the definition and mapper; entities.py:543 docstring 'local_status is never touched'; stream_persistence.py:283; analytics/cli.py:580.
why_tests_miss: Store tests call methods directly; no test drives a stream fill into fills; *_pg.py skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL.
recommendation: Add a fills writer on the stream/REST fill path in the same transaction as the order update, move local_status from stream events, reopen 20D-01 until an end-to-end test passes.

component: funding gap definition (case input, sufficiency, engine coverage)
summary: Every funding hole check uses 8 h + 60 s as tolerance whatever the inferred cadence, so a missed tick of a 4 h (or 1 h) series is not detected, contrary to the engine docstring.
expected: A missing instant of a 4 h series is a hole that is refused or must be declared.
actual: Probe: 4 h series with the 08:00 tick removed -> gap_ranges_for_files [], funding_holes (), check_funding_coverage returns () for a window spanning it.
impact: Funding cost understated by one settlement per missed tick (about 0.01 R each at 0.01 % rate, 50 % equity notional); research bias only, no order-path effect.
evidence: case_input.py:81 FUNDING_TOLERANCE_MS = FUNDING_MAX_CADENCE + FUNDING_JITTER; case_input.py:472-473; sufficiency.py:105-106,313-334; funding.py:240.
why_tests_miss: No test with a 4 h series missing one tick; docstring and tolerance written together.
recommendation: Use inferred cadence + jitter as tolerance (or the exchange fundingIntervalHours history); otherwise correct the docstring.
